name: rvl
description: Numeric and domain-agnostic non-numeric change explainer — finds the smallest set of cell-level changes or deterministic structural transitions that account for the difference between two tabular files (CSV, TSV, JSONL, Parquet, XLSX; the two may differ in format). Deprecated aliases kept for one release: `rvl --robot-triage` and `rvl doctor --robot-triage` (both now emit the cmdrvl.doctor.v1 triage report), `rvl doctor health`, and `--capsule-out` (use --capsule-dir).

usage: rvl --robot-triage (deprecated alias of: rvl doctor triage --json)

arguments.name: old
arguments.description: Old input: CSV, TSV, JSONL, Parquet or XLSX/XLS (required for compare mode)

arguments.name: new
arguments.description: New input: CSV, TSV, JSONL, Parquet or XLSX/XLS (required for compare mode). The two inputs may be different formats.

options.name: sheet
options.description: Worksheet (name or 0-based index) for both inputs when they are workbooks; required when a workbook has several sheets

options.name: old_sheet
options.description: Worksheet for the old input (overrides --sheet)

options.name: new_sheet
options.description: Worksheet for the new input (overrides --sheet)

options.name: key
options.description: Align rows by this key column (otherwise align by row order)

options.name: key_mode
options.description: Key-set policy: exact requires equal sets; overlap compares continuing rows only and reports membership counts (key samples require --explicit). Requires --key or a profile key.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Coverage target: 0 < x <= 1

options.name: tolerance
options.description: Per-cell noise floor: x >= 0

options.name: delimiter
options.description: Force CSV delimiter (comma/tab/semicolon/pipe/caret, 0xNN, or single ASCII byte)

options.name: exhaustive
options.description: Emit every changed numeric cell above tolerance instead of the smallest explanation prefix

options.name: audit_fields
options.description: With --exhaustive and an active profile, emit exact changes in profile-scoped non-numeric fields

options.name: non_numeric
options.description: Compare common non-numeric columns without a profile: deterministic date shifts, categorical transitions with affected-row refs, text churn, nullity flips and row churn

options.name: max_audit_changes
options.description: Maximum changed cells to emit in audit modes

options.name: profile
options.description: Use profile YAML at this path for key derivation and column scoping

options.name: profile_id
options.description: Resolve profile by ID from ~/.cmdrvl/config/profile/profiles/*.yaml; legacy ~/.epistemic/profiles is copied on first default use

options.name: lock
options.description: Verify both inputs against pinned lock.v0 lockfile(s) before comparing (exact path match, else unique basename). Refuses E_INPUT_NOT_LOCKED when an input is absent, E_INPUT_DRIFT when its bytes differ from the pinned hash. Verified lockfile identities are reported in the JSON `lock` field and the witness record.

options.name: capsule_dir
options.description: Write deterministic repro capsule artifacts to this directory (default: disabled). --capsule-out is a deprecated alias.

options.name: exit_zero_on_change
options.description: Exit 0 instead of 1 on REAL_CHANGE so `set -e` pipelines do not abort on an expected change. Refusals still exit 2; never changes `doctor` exit codes.

options.name: json
options.description: Emit JSON output (single object)

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress witness ledger recording

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show raw data values in output (default: redacted for zero-retention safety)

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0 without positional args

options.name: schema
options.description: Print JSON Schema for rvl.v0 output format and exit 0

options.name: version
options.description: Print version and exit 0

options.name: robot_triage
options.description: Deprecated alias of `rvl doctor triage --json`: emits the cmdrvl.doctor.v1 triage report without positional args

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Top-level machine-readable capability contract for headless agents (this document)

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Top-level paste-ready operating notes for agents

current_runtime_behavior.unreadable_ledger: exit 2, empty stdout, one stderr line naming the path
ledger_path_resolution: legacy ~/.epistemic/witness.jsonl is copied on first default use

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only diagnostics emitting cmdrvl.doctor.v1: `doctor [--json]` (health), `doctor capabilities --json` (embeds this contract), `doctor triage --json` (next_actions). Exit 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy, 2 usage error. Deprecated aliases: `doctor health [--json]`, `doctor --robot-triage`.

refusals.message: Unsupported text encoding (UTF-16/32 BOM or NUL bytes)
Key sets differ between files; next_command provides an opt-in overlap rerun
No continuing keys in overlap mode
Row count mismatch and no key provided
Cannot deterministically align without a key
Profile could not be resolved from ID
Profile column registry could not be loaded
Mixed numeric and non-numeric values in column
Field audit requires an active profile
Input file is not pinned in the --lock lockfile(s)
Input bytes differ from the hash pinned in the lockfile
A JSONL, Parquet or XLSX input was refused by the shared reader; detail.tabular_code carries its typed code (E_AMBIGUOUS_SHEET, E_SHEET_NOT_FOUND, E_UNSUPPORTED_VALUE, E_FORMAT, ...)
RVL_REDACTION_KEY is set but empty or shorter than 16 bytes (checked for --non-numeric runs; never falls back to ordinal refs)

env_vars.name: RVL_REDACTION_KEY
env_vars.description: Optional operator-held key (at least 16 bytes) for --non-numeric. When set, redacted values and row identities become stable HMAC-SHA256 markers (redacted:hmac-sha256:<32 hex>) instead of per-output ordinal refs (redacted:ref:v1.., redacted:ref:k1..). Set but empty or too short refuses with E_REDACTION_KEY_INVALID. The value is never printed, logged or written to the witness ledger.

env_vars.name: EPISTEMIC_WITNESS
env_vars.description: Overrides the witness ledger path for comparison runs; doctor commands do not write it.

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: Used to resolve ~/.cmdrvl default state and config paths; doctor commands do not write them.

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Any value disables ANSI styling in clap help and error output.

env_vars.name: TERM
env_vars.description: TERM=dumb disables ANSI styling; output is also unstyled whenever stdout/stderr is not a TTY.

env_vars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
env_vars.description: Unix seconds used instead of the wall clock for the witness record timestamp (reproducible builds convention).

side_effects.notes: Comparison runs append one witness record unless --no-witness; --capsule-dir writes replay artifacts only when given. capabilities, robot-docs and doctor are read-only.

robot_triage.output: deprecated alias of rvl doctor triage --json

set_e_safe.output: exit 0 on REAL_CHANGE; refusals still exit 2

fix_mode.behavior: exits 2, emits only stderr, and names read-only alternatives

accepts.description: The same CSV pair, key, and profile choices that passed a preceding shape gate.

agent_rules: Prefer shape before rvl when the task compares two tabular datasets.
Keep key, profile, delimiter, and tolerance assumptions explicit across shape and rvl.
Use rvl output as evidence for assess; rvl does not make policy decisions.
